# Colophon

The last chapter of the book, carrying no placement marker of its own: under
M063's rule it is therefore the chapter that carries every index no marker
names, appended at the end of its body. It sits after `four.qmd` so that the
chapter a check gives a marker to between two renders, or whose record a check
makes unwritable, is never this one.

A third term for the index no marker names: [Escutcheon]{.index index="gamma"}.
